Read-only selected-text final review. No tools/access/settings. Source evidence is supplied by editor, NOT independently retrieved by you: actual BDB7779 https://biblehub.com/bdb/7779.htm glosses shuf bruise and lists both forms of Gen3:15; BDB2233 https://biblehub.com/bdb/2233.htm section4 lists Gen3:15 under collective animal offspring and seed of woman, but other sections include particular-child uses. BDB779 https://biblehub.com/bdb/779.htm lists Gen3:14 passive-participle curse formula. These lexicon observations are not manuscript collation. Evaluate selected ko/en/es for Gen3:11-15. Explicitly correct overstatements in your initial response: le-kha v11 is to-you dative, not accusative; do not reproduce Korean character contamination in quoted Hebrew v14. Raw initial quotations are not display source. Do NOT claim absolute proof that shuf must always mean the same degree of injury in both clauses, nor that masculine singular or collective zera makes an individual referent impossible. Context-dependent different-verb translations remain alternatives; same-verb symmetry is our current editorial choice. Do not claim unspecified LXX/Vulgate witnesses all read the same without verifying a particular edition/witness. No certain ancient anatomy, chronology, guilt motives or exclusively symbolic dust. V12 gave/gave and emphatic she retained; Korean from-the-tree thing is disclosed ellipsis expansion. V14 comparison selected, separation/among alternatives remain. V14-15 is a speech to serpent; close this quote at15, do not assert same-address speech continues through19, which includes other addressees. V15 offspring repetition plus Spanish feminine descendencia/la reflects Spanish agreement, not Hebrew feminine subject; masculine hu is preserved in notes. No named Jesus/Mary/Satan insertion, while later readings can be discussed separately. Return JSON {opinions:[{id,verdict,final_opinion_ko,counterargument_ko}],final_opinion_ko} all five IDs. Material errors should be reported, not flattery.
